change: Opt-in extent-first owned-group alternatives preserve the existing nearest-pad forward/reverse candidates. Two bounded extent sweeps use whole-group envelope area, member-to-origin extent to escape masked-envelope ties, then pad gap and deterministic coordinates. Each eligible member/sweep checks at most 256 poses. Final independent geometry and original pad-gap non-regression checks remain mandatory.
activation: board --compact-placement --owned-extent-alternatives; diagnostic profiler --compact-search on --owned-extent-alternatives on. Default off; independent of owned-quality-first.
permissions: No new side, rotation or movement permissions. Owners, bulk capacitors, fixed refs and top-access restrictions remain unchanged. No invented numerical hardware proximity limits.
accounting: All executed scalar calls retained, including duplicate and rejected trials. Result reports actual trial checks and exhausted per-member budgets; adapter publishes them in search diagnostics. An unexecuted 257th pose is not counted.

local_proof.checks: Fresh final geometry, no overlap or bound violation, identical nets/sides/rotations, no original owned pad gap increase, retained proximity incumbents, deterministic declaration permutation, exact scalar counts and explicit exhausted-search receipts.
local_proof.expanded_adversarial_coverage: Extent alternatives also exercised with opposite sides, through-hole obstacles, all quadrant rotations, sub-grid rounding boundaries and translated coordinate frames.

screen_results: All completed screens pass placement-contract/flow diagnostics with zero hard composition RED. Neither carrier screen demonstrates a smaller whole board. Unrestricted carrier changes relative to the locked reference already occur with extent OFF and must not be attributed to this feature.
failed_work: Initial synthetic fixture had a fixed overlap and was corrected. Simple extent ranking and then revisiting with distance-first ties failed the valid masked-envelope test; member extent tie-breaking resolved it. First devkit screen used a nonexistent schematic filename and failed before construction; rerun used the verified Zynq_Carrier.kicad_sch path. Initial precision-test target name was corrected after Ninja rejected it.
decision: Retain as a bounded opt-in capability with a concrete local compactness proof, not as the default or an accepted smaller carrier. Current matched carrier showed extra work without a board change; investigate layout bottlenecks beyond these two pilots before broadening campaigns.
limits: Single construction samples with uncontrolled caches/load and diagnostic overhead; no speedup or historical Python comparison. No new complete board qualification, DRC or rendered finalist. Qualitative proximity, assembly/thermal unknowns, hardware qualification and overall goal remain incomplete.
